scope.description: Minimum sum of squared entries over the original length and two moments.
Minimum sum of squared entries over the original length and two moments.

question_only_review.original_constraints: A length-four histogram with nonnegative integer counts encodes exactly a multiset on 1 through 4. Verify the length and weighted first/fourth moments; compute the second moment separately.

rows.weak_necessary: Square and value have the same residue modulo 2, so the second moment is odd.

scope.description: Minimum count of grapes eaten by the winner over the feasible contest sizes.
Minimum count of grapes eaten by the winner over the feasible contest sizes.

question_only_review.original_constraints: With m children and winner n, the given step-two progression is nonnegative iff its last count is nonnegative. Its sum is m(n+1-m).

rows.weak_necessary: The quadratic in the number of children is at most (n+1)^2/4, which must cover the given total.

scope.description: Largest positive integer input n to the prescribed floor-log sum.
Largest positive integer input n to the prescribed floor-log sum.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Exact decimal digit divisions compute floor(log10(k*n)) for every one of the 100 required positive terms.

rows.weak_necessary: At n=1000, each term is at least 3 and k=10 already exceeds 3. Monotonicity excludes every larger input.

scope.description: Smallest positive n in the specified integer-factorizable polynomial.
Smallest positive n in the specified integer-factorizable polynomial.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Both factor degrees must be positive. Integer coefficient convolution in ascending powers must equal the prescribed quartic coefficient vector.

rows.weak_necessary: Only the original positive-integer domain is used as the weak control here.

scope.description: Smallest positive n with both prescribed decimal digit sums.
Smallest positive n with both prescribed decimal digit sums.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Decimal quotient/remainder division computes both required digit sums exactly on n and n+864.

rows.weak_necessary: Decimal digit sum has the same residue as the original integer modulo 9.

scope.description: Least positive m such that the prescribed polynomial has at least four prime factors counting multiplicity.
Least positive m such that the prescribed polynomial has at least four prime factors counting multiplicity.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Validate positive m, four or more factors, primality of each listed factor, multiplicity and equality of their product.

rows.weak_necessary: The polynomial is odd; four prime factors have product at least 3^4, so m must be at least 9.

scope.description: Least possible m+n over the original positive integer pair and all three divisibility constraints.
Least possible m+n over the original positive integer pair and all three divisibility constraints.

question_only_review.original_constraints: For positive integers, prime valuations characterize the power divisibility. Also verify the coprime sum and the ordinary nondivisibility.

rows.weak_necessary: The positive sum is at least 2 and coprime to 210 by the original constraints.

scope.description: Least positive value N, expressed in decimal, with the two original digit patterns.
Least positive value N, expressed in decimal, with the two original digit patterns.

question_only_review.original_constraints: The shared digits must belong to base eight. The leading digit in base eleven must be nonzero. Horner evaluation checks equality, with the fixed leading 1 in base eight.

rows.weak_necessary: The base-eight value is at least 512. The three shared digits are at most 7, giving base-eleven value at most 931.

scope.description: Least positive index n where the exact expression is divisible by 1000.
Least positive index n where the exact expression is divisible by 1000.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Exact modular products test the required expression modulo 1000 at a positive integer index.

rows.weak_necessary: For positive n the divisibility expression modulo 2 forces n odd.

scope.description: Minimum number of adults after the bus arrives, with the original crowd and bus constraints.
Minimum number of adults after the bus arrives, with the original crowd and bus constraints.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Integral original adult count, bus occupancy and exact final proportion bind the final number of adults.

rows.weak_necessary: Integrality of the final adult count forces it to be a positive multiple of 11.

scope.description: Largest prime p below 1000 admitting the original integer complex number and a nondegenerate triangle.
Largest prime p below 1000 admitting the original integer complex number and a nondegenerate triangle.

question_only_review.original_constraints: Verify p prime below the bound, integer norm a^2+b^2, positive real/imaginary cubic components and all strict triangle inequalities.

rows.weak_necessary: An odd prime representable as a sum of two squares is 1 modulo 4 by the residues of squares.

source_cost_scope: Executable proposal audits are timed separately; author reading and manual derivation are not instrumented.
